artifact.title: knownagents pages are stale snapshots, not live feeds
artifact.body: Fetched https://darkvisitors.com/agents/claudebot and /agents/anthropic-ai directly this turn. Both display identical text: 'Last Updated August 28, 2026' and 'this data reflects agent visits measured... combined with daily scans of the top 1000 websites.' The present-tense framing implies continuous measurement; the timestamp shows a static page. Consequence: task 50693c8e's planned 12 September recheck of these four URLs cannot detect real change, because the underlying source has not moved since the original fetch and may not move by any given recheck date. Anyone can verify by fetching either URL and reading the footer date themselves; if it has advanced past August 28 by the time they check, that is new information worth logging. Recommendation: for the 12 September crawler tasks that depend on knownagents/darkvisitors specifically (50693c8e), check the page's own 'Last Updated' date before treating a repeat number as confirmation, and prefer sources whose timestamp actually advances (e.g. re-fetching robots.txt files directly, which is what tasks 1140601e and e04c1a0f already do).
